action_items: MINOR: Fix nested button HTML issue in AdminPanel.js - the 'Add Valet' button is placed inside the CollapsibleTrigger button element. Move the Add Valet button outside the trigger or restructure the header layout.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.js line 276-284: The 'Add Valet' Button is nested inside the CollapsibleTrigger which renders as a button. This causes HTML validation error '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. Consider using a div with onClick for the trigger instead of button, or restructure the header to have the Add Valet button outside the trigger area.
